checks.name: snapshot_plan_known_at
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM eta_snapshot s LEFT JOIN eta_trip_plan_version p ON s.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND s.trip_version_id=p.trip_version_id WHERE p.trip_version_id IS NULL OR p.plan_known_at>s.snapshot_time OR p.trip_id<>s.trip_id OR p.vehicle_id<>s.vehicle_id

checks.name: snapshot_promise_known_at
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM eta_snapshot s LEFT JOIN eta_promise_version p ON s.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND s.promise_version_id=p.promise_version_id WHERE p.promise_version_id IS NULL OR p.known_at>s.snapshot_time OR p.trip_id<>s.trip_id

checks.name: snapshot_position_known_at
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM eta_snapshot s LEFT JOIN telemetry_event p ON s.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND s.selected_position_event_id=p.canonical_event_id WHERE s.selected_position_event_id IS NOT NULL AND (p.canonical_event_id IS NULL OR p.available_time>s.snapshot_time OR p.event_time>s.snapshot_time OR p.vehicle_id<>s.vehicle_id OR p.device_id<>s.device_id)

checks.name: position_age_calculation
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM eta_snapshot WHERE position_age_seconds<>date_diff('second',last_position_time,snapshot_time) OR position_age_seconds<0

checks.name: snapshot_position_validity
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM eta_snapshot WHERE (position_validity='no_position' AND (latitude_deg IS NOT NULL OR selected_position_event_id IS NOT NULL)) OR latitude_deg NOT BETWEEN -90 AND 90 OR longitude_deg NOT BETWEEN -180 AND 180 OR remaining_distance_km<0

checks.name: snapshots_have_one_label
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM eta_snapshot s LEFT JOIN eta_snapshot_label l USING(tenant_id,snapshot_id) WHERE l.snapshot_id IS NULL

checks.name: labels_match_snapshot_promise
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM eta_snapshot_label l JOIN eta_snapshot s USING(tenant_id,snapshot_id) WHERE l.promise_version_id<>s.promise_version_id

checks.name: label_cutoff_is_exclusive
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM eta_snapshot_label l JOIN eta_snapshot s USING(tenant_id,snapshot_id) JOIN eta_split_assignment sp USING(tenant_id,trip_id) JOIN eta_trip_outcome o ON l.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND l.outcome_version_id=o.outcome_version_id WHERE o.label_available_time>=sp.label_cutoff_at

checks.name: latest_outcome_before_cutoff
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM eta_snapshot_label l JOIN eta_snapshot s USING(tenant_id,snapshot_id) JOIN eta_split_assignment sp USING(tenant_id,trip_id) JOIN eta_trip_outcome o ON l.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND l.outcome_version_id=o.outcome_version_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM eta_trip_outcome later WHERE later.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND later.trip_id=s.trip_id AND later.label_available_time<sp.label_cutoff_at AND later.label_available_time>o.label_available_time)

checks.name: eligible_targets_use_arrival_not_service
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM eta_snapshot_label l JOIN eta_snapshot s USING(tenant_id,snapshot_id) JOIN eta_trip_outcome o ON l.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND l.outcome_version_id=o.outcome_version_id WHERE l.label_eligibility='eligible' AND (o.label_status<>'verified' OR o.arrival_time_precision NOT IN ('second','minute') OR l.remaining_duration_seconds<>date_diff('second',s.snapshot_time,o.actual_arrival_time) OR l.remaining_duration_seconds<=0 OR l.delay_outcome IS NULL)

checks.name: delay_uses_frozen_promise
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM eta_snapshot_label l JOIN eta_promise_version p USING(tenant_id,promise_version_id) JOIN eta_trip_outcome o ON l.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND l.outcome_version_id=o.outcome_version_id WHERE l.label_eligibility='eligible' AND l.delay_outcome<>(o.actual_arrival_time>p.window_end_at)

checks.name: unknown_not_zero_or_on_time
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM eta_snapshot_label WHERE label_eligibility<>'eligible' AND (remaining_duration_seconds IS NOT NULL OR delay_outcome IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: history_training_only_no_self
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM eta_history_reference h JOIN eta_snapshot s USING(tenant_id,snapshot_id) JOIN eta_split_assignment sp ON h.tenant_id=sp.tenant_id AND h.historical_trip_id=sp.trip_id WHERE sp.split_role<>'train' OR h.historical_trip_id=s.trip_id OR h.historical_label_known_at>=s.snapshot_time OR h.historical_label_known_at>=TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01T07:00:00Z'

checks.name: history_independent_departure_duration
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM eta_history_reference h JOIN eta_trip_outcome o ON h.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND h.historical_outcome_version_id=o.outcome_version_id WHERE o.arrival_time_precision NOT IN ('second','minute') OR h.historical_duration_seconds<>(SELECT date_diff('second',min(e.occurred_at),o.actual_arrival_time) FROM eta_trip_event e WHERE e.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND e.trip_id=h.historical_trip_id AND e.event_type='departure')

checks.name: provenance_fk_snapshots_labels_history
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT provenance_id FROM eta_snapshot UNION ALL SELECT provenance_id FROM eta_snapshot_label UNION ALL SELECT provenance_id FROM eta_history_reference) d LEFT JOIN provenance_record p USING(provenance_id) WHERE p.provenance_id IS NULL

checks.name: snapshot_derived_availability
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM eta_snapshot s JOIN provenance_record p USING(provenance_id) WHERE p.available_time<>s.snapshot_time OR p.origin_type<>'derived'

checks.name: source_availability_after_event
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM telemetry_event WHERE available_time<event_time

checks.name: split_groups_are_trip_unique
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT tenant_id,trip_id,count(DISTINCT split_role) n FROM eta_split_assignment GROUP BY tenant_id,trip_id HAVING n<>1)

checks.name: arrival_service_delivery_chronology
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM eta_trip_outcome WHERE service_start_time<actual_arrival_time OR delivery_completed_time<service_start_time
